# Hunter full arena — fixture version 1

`save.arenic.json` is a complete, validated **schema-7 SaveDocument** for slot 0.
Fixture version **1** and domain seed **20260913** are independent of save schema,
envelope format and authored content versions. Its fixed run identity and times
make the generated bytes reproducible. The fixture is outside the runtime PCK;
it does not change `ArenicSaveSeed`, the title screen or gameplay resources.

The saved run contains 40 folded ghosts in Hunter's normal-difficulty Labyrinth:
five each of Hunter, Cardinal, Warrior, Thief, Bard, Merchant, Alchemist and
Forager. Every hero has its original class resource, level 1, 0 XP, the default
100-XP display threshold, default one-point health, and only slot 1's authored
starter ability. All active selection flags are false; identity 0 remains the
remembered hero. The introduction is complete. Initial damage, prospecting,
wood and gold are zero, and no bags or combat effects are pre-awarded.

Labyrinth starts at tick 0 with `restart_pending=true` and `paused=false`.
Continue therefore supplies the normal three-second countdown before playback.
Other arena clocks start at 0 without pending restarts. Each of the 40 recordings
contains an explicit final slot-1 intent at tick 7199, covering the entire
7200-tick/120-second interval. A final intent can correctly be refused by current
range, cooldown or active-ability rules; it does not force an accepted cast.

## Formation and routes

The offline compiler predicts the authored boss's next station 180 ticks ahead,
then records only one-cell cardinal movement and default-ability intents. Each
hero has a distinct formation position and movement phase. Movement reservations
avoid occupied starting/destination cells and swaps. The normal contact resolver
still runs on every planning and verification tick.

- Hunters and Cardinals cover opposite ranged flanks.
- Warriors approach the north edge; Thieves move behind the north-facing boss.
- Bards cleanse from the west edge, retaining ordinary damage, DOT and healing.
- Merchants carry their ordinary Fortune aura along the east edge.
- Alchemists approach real casting facings and place 3×3 acid areas wholly inside
  the current boss footprint, leaving friendly lanes clear.
- Foragers prepare distinct columns of future landing ground, then prospect
  additional tiles. Actual Dig fields produce both attributed hazard damage and
  the normal recruitment income.

The planner avoids current and pending acid pools and steps outward from the
real upcoming blast radius. It does not edit health, suppress contact, disable
boss attacks or invent death events. All 40 happen to survive this version's
verified loop. Stored playback uses no planner or AI: it consumes the compiled
intent recordings through the ordinary merged encounter timeline.

## Rebuild and proof

From the repository root:

```bash
python3 scripts/fixtures/build-hunter-full-arena.py
```

The wrapper imports a disposable copy under `.tmp/hunter-full-arena-seed`, copies
the offline GDScript into that copy, generates all intentions through the real
RunSetup/hero/combat/encounter APIs, validates the complete SaveDocument, hydrates
it through the codec, and runs another **7200 actual model ticks**. It requires
exact equality of per-hero/per-class accepted casts, damage, deaths, prospecting
and end-of-loop survivors between compilation and replay. It also checks exact
full-payload JSON round-trip equality. Initial countdown rendering and actual
shell/browser playback are separate checks owned by the capture/browser tools.

`manifest.json` lists all 40 staffs, start cells, event counts, last intentions,
accepted casts and damage, plus source hashes and the save-file SHA-256. Rebuild
refuses changed version-1 model/data/compiler inputs; create a new named fixture
version when changing those inputs. Logs and diagnostic payloads remain under
`.tmp/hunter-full-arena-seed`, outside the fixture.

The verified first loop has **31,267 intents, 2,311 damage, 738 prospecting and
40 survivors**, with zero deaths and default stats throughout:

| Class | Accepted casts | Damage | Prospecting |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Hunter | 183 | 172 | 0 |
| Cardinal | 321 | 174 | 0 |
| Warrior | 310 | 266 | 0 |
| Thief | 515 | 471 | 0 |
| Bard | 114 | 654 | 0 |
| Merchant | 30 | 250 | 0 |
| Alchemist | 91 | 250 | 0 |
| Forager | 374 | 74 | 738 |

Cooldowns and range remain real. An indefinite Cardinal channel may be accepted
again after a recorded move cancels it; Merchant's accepted aura continues
working between casts. Every individual hero casts and contributes damage.
Ordinary cycle reset clears carried/temporary work and revives ghosts as usual,
while cumulative damage and prospecting remain banked.

## Play or capture

Use Godot **4.7.2** and choose a new, empty output directory for every launch.
Interactive preview opens the real seeded game through its native save backend:

```bash
python3 scripts/capture-hunter-cycle.py --preview --output .tmp/hunter-seed-preview-v2
```

Full movie capture also requires `ffmpeg` and `ffprobe` on `PATH`:

```bash
python3 scripts/capture-hunter-cycle.py --output .tmp/hunter-seed-movie-v2
```

Capture **v2** uses this same frozen seed **v1**. Its complete movie is exactly
**131 seconds / 7,860 frames at 60 fps**: the initial three-second countdown,
120 seconds of forward gameplay, five seconds of reverse playback at 24×,
and the final three-second countdown. Short recordings retain at least the
configured 10× reverse rate; the five-second cap speeds up longer histories.
Expected phase frames are `0, 180, 7380, 7680, 7860`. The helper captures the
actual native game and writes its logs and outputs into the isolated directory.
The movie is named `hunter-full-arena-v2.mp4`; the seed bytes and schema remain
unchanged. The original hosted capture v1 retains its 138-second / 12-second
reverse and remains a separate historical artifact.

After the new capture and media proof pass, create a separate v2 package:

```bash
python3 scripts/capture/package-hunter-capture.py \
  --capture-dir .tmp/hunter-seed-movie-v2 \
  --output .tmp/hunter-capture-package-v2
```

The package contains `hunter-full-arena-v2.mp4`, `capture-proof-v2.json`,
`hunter-full-arena-repro-v2.zip`, and the unchanged
`hunter-full-arena-v1.arenic.json`, plus manifests and checksums. Packaging
requires a new or empty output directory and does not publish or replace the
existing hosted v1 assets. The proof format remains version 1; `capture_id`
and `capture_version` identify this new capture independently of the seed.

For the focused IndexedDB/reload check, serve an existing private QA export and
pass its site base URL to the standalone verifier:

```bash
node scripts/fixtures/verify-hunter-browser.mjs http://127.0.0.1:4182 .tmp/hunter-seed-browser-v1
```

The verifier creates a fresh browser context and loads the same frozen save.
It does not require a new production import hook or modify a player's database.

## Load into an isolated capture profile

Read the file as text, require `ArenicSaveDocument.decode(text, 0).ok`, then use
an **empty, dedicated** `ArenicNativeSaveBackend` directory:

```gdscript
await SaveGames.backend.write_record(0, 0, text)
await SaveGames.refresh()
await SaveGames.continue_game(0)
```

Inspect each operation's returned success status in the harness. Do not write
this fixed slot/run identity over a player's existing profile. The normal
SaveGames Continue path performs complete hydration and starts the countdown;
there is no production import API or special fixture format.
